# Elements: Overlays

> Plainkit 0.1.0-alpha.1. Generated by scripts/build-skills.mjs from core/dist/elements/api.json. Do not edit: change the source and run the generator.

Every element also takes the usual HTML global attributes (`id`, `class`, `slot`, `hidden`, `aria-*`, `data-*`). Never use a `style` attribute (the CSP blocks it): use props, parts and CSS custom properties.

## `pk-command-palette`

**Command palette** (Overlays). A keyboard-first launcher: Ctrl/Cmd+K opens a dialog with a search field over grouped commands, fuzzy-matched with highlights, recents when the field is empty, arrows and Enter to run.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `open` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether it is shown |
| `placeholder` | `placeholder` | string | `"Type a command or search…"` |  | The placeholder setting |
| `recents-key` | `recentsKey` | string | `"pk-palette-recents"` |  | localStorage key; empty disables recents. |
| `no-shortcut` | `noShortcut` | boolean | `false` |  | Do not bind Ctrl/Cmd+K on the document. |
| `label` | `label` | string | `"Command palette"` |  | Accessible name of the dialog. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-select` | `{ item: object }` | A command was chosen; navigates to href when it has one and the event is not cancelled. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `show()` | Opens it |
| `hide()` | Closes it |
| `items (property)` | { id, label, group?, hint?, keywords?, href?, shortcut? }[] (property only). |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `dialog` | The native dialog |
| `search` | Search row |
| `input` | Text field |
| `hint` | Keyboard hint |
| `list` | The results list (group headings and option rows are built inside it) |
| `empty` | Empty state text |
| `status` | Live status region |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-palette-w` | `min(40rem, viewport)` | Palette width |

**Accessibility.** A native modal dialog; the input is a combobox controlling a listbox with aria-activedescendant; a polite status announces the result count; groups are labelled.

Example: Command palette

```html
<pk-command-palette></pk-command-palette>
```

## `pk-context-menu`

**Context menu** (Overlays). A menu opened at the pointer by right click, by Shift+F10 or the Menu key, or by a touch long press, over the region it wraps.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `open` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether the menu is shown. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | boolean | `false` |  | Leave the browser menu alone. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The region the menu belongs to. |
| `menu` | pk-menu-item children. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-select` | `{ item: element, value: string, checked: boolean }` | An item was chosen. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `showAt(x, y)` | See the description |
| `hide()` | Closes it |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `menu` | The menu layer |

**Accessibility.** The menu is role=menu and takes focus on open; the region is not made focusable, so the keyboard route is the region’s own focusable content plus Shift+F10 or the Menu key.

Example: Right-click, long-press or Shift+F10

```html
<pk-context-menu><pk-card><p>Right-click here.</p></pk-card><pk-menu-item slot="menu">Rename</pk-menu-item><pk-menu-item slot="menu">Duplicate</pk-menu-item><pk-menu-item slot="menu" danger>Delete</pk-menu-item></pk-context-menu>
```

## `pk-dialog`

**Dialog** (Overlays). A native modal dialog in five sizes with a scrolling body, full screen on a phone; plus confirm, alert and prompt patterns that return a promise. The backdrop never closes it: every dialog offers its own Cancel or Close. Declarative openers: data-open="#id", data-toggle and data-close work without any script (installed when the element connects).

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `open` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether it is shown |
| `heading` | `heading` | string | `""` |  | The heading setting |
| `size` | `size` | enum | `"md"` | `sm` `md` `lg` `xl` `fullscreen` | The size setting |
| `scrollable` | `scrollable` | boolean | `false` |  | The body scrolls inside a bounded dialog. |
| `hide-close` | `hideClose` | boolean | `false` |  | Hide the header close button (the dialog offers its own Cancel in the footer). |
| `max-width` | `maxWidth` | number | `0` |  | Card width in pixels before the viewport clamp; 0 keeps the size preset. |
| `tint` | `tint` | enum | `"none"` | `none` `product` `archived` | A tinted card: product (green wash) or archived (red wash). |
| `controlled` | `controlled` | boolean | `false` |  | The host owns open: close requests (Escape, close button, backdrop, swipe) only raise pk-close and never close the element; the host closes it by clearing open. Used by Blazor wrappers. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `header` | Custom header. |
| (default) | Body. |
| `footer` | Actions. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-open` | `none` | pk-open |
| `pk-close` | `{ reason: string }` | escape, close button or method. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `show()` | Opens it |
| `hide()` | Closes it |
| `PkDialog.confirm(options) -> Promise<boolean>` | See the description |
| `PkDialog.alert(options) -> Promise<void>` | See the description |
| `PkDialog.prompt(options) -> Promise<string\|null>` | See the description |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `dialog` | The native dialog |
| `header` | Header row |
| `title` | Heading text |
| `close` | Close or dismiss button |
| `body` | Main content |
| `footer` | Footer row |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-dialog-w` | `min(35rem, viewport)` | Dialog width |

**Accessibility.** Native <dialog>: focus is trapped and returned by the browser, the page behind is inert, Escape closes; labelled by its heading. A destructive confirm focuses Cancel.

Example: Dialog with a footer

```html
<pk-dialog heading="Discard this draft?" size="sm"><p>Escape closes this, Tab stays inside, and focus returns to the button that opened it.</p><pk-button slot="footer" variant="ghost">Cancel</pk-button><pk-button slot="footer" variant="warn">Discard</pk-button></pk-dialog>
```

## `pk-drawer`

**Drawer** (Overlays). A panel that slides in from the left, right or bottom over a dimmed page, on a native modal dialog: backdrop, focus trap and Escape come with it. A bottom sheet has a grab handle and swipe-to-close on touch. Declarative openers: data-open="#id", data-toggle and data-close work without any script (installed when the element connects).

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `open` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether it is shown |
| `side` | `side` | enum | `"right"` | `left` `right` `bottom` | Edge it slides from. |
| `heading` | `heading` | string | `""` |  | Title; also the accessible name. |
| `persistent` | `persistent` | boolean | `false` |  | The backdrop does not close it. |
| `wide` | `wide` | boolean | `false` |  | A wider panel (up to 70% of the viewport). |
| `controlled` | `controlled` | boolean | `false` |  | The host owns open: close requests (Escape, close button, backdrop, swipe) only raise pk-close and never close the element; the host closes it by clearing open. Used by Blazor wrappers. |
| `docked` | `docked` | boolean | `false` |  | A non-modal inspector: it sits inside the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the viewport, has no backdrop and no focus trap, and the page behind stays usable. Escape still asks to close. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `header` | Custom header content. |
| (default) | Body. |
| `footer` | Actions. |
| `actions` | Actions strip under the header (Save, Cancel). |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-open` | `none` | pk-open |
| `pk-close` | `{ reason: string }` | escape, backdrop, close button, swipe or method. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `show()` | Opens it |
| `hide()` | Closes it |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `panel` | The floating panel |
| `handle` | Grab handle of a bottom sheet |
| `header` | Header row |
| `title` | Heading text |
| `close` | Close or dismiss button |
| `body` | Main content |
| `footer` | Footer row |
| `actions` | Actions strip under the header |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-drawer-w` | `min(24rem, 90vw)` | Side drawer width |
| `--pk-drawer-h` | `85dvh` | Bottom sheet maximum height |

**Accessibility.** A native modal dialog with an accessible name; focus returns to the opener on close; Escape and the backdrop close it (set persistent to keep the backdrop inert).

Example: Drawer from the right

```html
<pk-drawer side="right" heading="Filters"><p>Filter controls go here.</p><pk-button slot="footer">Apply</pk-button></pk-drawer>
```

## `pk-dropdown`

**Dropdown menu** (Overlays). A menu opened from a trigger: buttons or links, headers, dividers, checkable items and submenus, with full keyboard support (arrows, Home, End, typeahead, Right/Left for submenus, Escape).

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `open` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether the menu is shown. |
| `placement` | `placement` | string | `"bottom-start"` |  | Preferred side. |
| `keep-open` | `keepOpen` | boolean | `false` |  | Stay open after an item is chosen (multi-select filters). |
| `mega` | `mega` | boolean | `false` |  | A wide panel whose items flow into columns (navbar mega menu). |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `trigger` | The button that opens it. |
| (default) | pk-menu-item children. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-select` | `{ item: element, value: string, checked: boolean }` | An item was chosen. |
| `pk-open` | `none` | Opened. |
| `pk-close` | `{ reason: string }` | Closed. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `show()` | Opens it |
| `hide()` | Closes it |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `menu` | The menu layer |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-dropdown-min-w` | `12rem` | Minimum menu width |

**Accessibility.** Trigger has aria-haspopup=menu and aria-expanded; the menu is role=menu; items are menuitem, menuitemcheckbox or menuitemradio; focus moves to the first item on keyboard open and returns to the trigger on close.

Example: Menu with a header, checkable items and a submenu

```html
<pk-dropdown><pk-button slot="trigger" variant="ghost">Actions</pk-button><pk-menu-item type="header">Order</pk-menu-item><pk-menu-item>Edit</pk-menu-item><pk-menu-item type="checkbox" checked>Show archived</pk-menu-item><pk-menu-item type="divider"></pk-menu-item><pk-menu-item danger>Delete</pk-menu-item></pk-dropdown>
```

## `pk-lightbox`

**Lightbox** (Overlays). A full-screen image viewer on a native dialog: caption, counter, previous and next with arrow keys and swipe, neighbours preloaded, only safe image sources.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | `index` | number | `0` |  | The index setting |
| `label` | `label` | string | `"Image viewer"` |  | Accessible name |
| `open` | `open` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether it is shown |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The trigger. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-change` | `{ index: number }` | Another image is shown. |
| `pk-close` | `{ reason: string }` | pk-close |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `show(index)` | See the description |
| `hide()` | Closes it |
| `items (property)` | { src, alt, caption }[] (property only). |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `dialog` | The native dialog |
| `close` | Close or dismiss button |
| `prev` | Previous control |
| `next` | Next control |
| `figure` | Image and caption |
| `image` | The image |
| `caption` | Caption text |
| `counter` | Position counter |

**Accessibility.** Native dialog with a label; the image has alt text from the item; the counter is a polite status; arrow keys and swipe navigate, Escape closes.

Example: Lightbox trigger

```html
<pk-lightbox label="Product images"><pk-button variant="ghost">Open the gallery</pk-button></pk-lightbox>
```

## `pk-menu-item`

**Menu item** (Overlays). One row of a dropdown or context menu: a plain item, a checkbox, a radio, a section header or a divider; optional prefix and suffix (shortcut) and a nested submenu.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `type` | enum | `"item"` | `item` `checkbox` `radio` `header` `divider` | What the row is. |
| `checked` | `checked` | boolean | `false` |  | Checkbox and radio state. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | boolean | `false` |  | Skipped by keyboard, not activatable. |
| `danger` | `danger` | boolean | `false` |  | Destructive styling. |
| `value` | `value` | string | `""` |  | Reported in pk-select; defaults to the label. |
| `href` | `href` | string | `""` |  | Renders as a link. |
| `open` | `open` | boolean | `false` |  | A submenu is open. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Label. |
| `prefix` | Icon before the label. |
| `suffix` | Shortcut or badge after it. |
| `submenu` | Nested pk-menu-item children. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-select` | `{ item: element, value: string, checked: boolean }` | Chosen (bubbles to the dropdown). |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `mark` | Check or radio mark |
| `label` | Label text |
| `chevron` | Submenu or branch chevron |
| `submenu` | The submenu layer |

**Accessibility.** The host takes role menuitem, menuitemcheckbox or menuitemradio (header and divider are presentation and separator); aria-checked and aria-disabled follow the props.

Example: Item types

```html
<div class="stack"><pk-menu-item type="header">Header</pk-menu-item><pk-menu-item>Plain item</pk-menu-item><pk-menu-item type="checkbox" checked>Checkbox</pk-menu-item><pk-menu-item type="radio" checked>Radio</pk-menu-item><pk-menu-item disabled>Disabled</pk-menu-item></div>
```

## `pk-popover`

**Popover** (Overlays). A small non-modal panel anchored to its trigger with a heading, body and actions; opens on click or hover, flips and shifts to stay on screen, closes on Escape, an outside press or focus leaving. variant="confirm" asks a yes/no question beside the control that was pressed. Declarative openers: data-open="#id", data-toggle and data-close work without any script (installed when the element connects).

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `open` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether the panel is shown. |
| `placement` | `placement` | string | `"bottom-start"` |  | Preferred side. |
| `trigger` | `trigger` | enum | `"click"` | `click` `hover` `manual` | What opens it. |
| `heading` | `heading` | string | `""` |  | Panel title. |
| `label` | `label` | string | `""` |  | Accessible name when there is no heading. |
| `variant` | `variant` | enum | `"default"` | `default` `confirm` | confirm adds Cancel and Confirm buttons. |
| `message` | `message` | string | `""` |  | Body text for the confirm variant. |
| `confirm-label` | `confirmLabel` | string | `"Confirm"` |  | Confirm button text. |
| `cancel-label` | `cancelLabel` | string | `"Cancel"` |  | Cancel button text. |
| `danger` | `danger` | boolean | `false` |  | Styles Confirm as destructive. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `trigger` | The control that opens it. |
| (default) | Panel body. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-open` | `none` | Panel opened. |
| `pk-close` | `{ reason: string }` | Panel closed (escape, outside, cancel, confirm, toggle). |
| `pk-confirm` | `none` | Confirm pressed (variant confirm). |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `show()` | Opens it |
| `hide()` | Closes it |
| `toggle()` | Toggles it |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `panel` | The floating panel |
| `title` | Heading text |
| `body` | Main content |
| `actions` | Action buttons |
| `cancel` | Cancel button |
| `confirm` | Confirm button |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-popover-w` | `--pop-w` | Panel width |

**Accessibility.** The trigger carries aria-expanded; the panel is role=dialog (role=alertdialog for confirm) with a label; focus moves in on keyboard open and returns to the trigger on close.

Example: Popover on click

```html
<pk-popover heading="Order 1042"><pk-button slot="trigger" variant="ghost">Details</pk-button>Placed Sep 12, three lines, shipping to Portland.</pk-popover>
```

Example: Confirmation popover

```html
<pk-popover variant="confirm" heading="Delete this line?" message="It cannot be undone." confirm-label="Delete" danger><pk-button slot="trigger" variant="warn">Delete line</pk-button></pk-popover>
```

## `pk-tooltip`

**Tooltip** (Overlays). A short label for the control it wraps, shown on hover, on keyboard focus and on a touch long press. Placed beside the target and flipped when it would leave the screen.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `text` | string | `""` |  | The label. |
| `placement` | `placement` | string | `"top"` |  | Preferred side; flips when it does not fit. |
| `delay` | `delay` | number | `400` |  | Mouse hover delay; focus is immediate. |
| `shown` | `shown` | boolean | `false` |  | Read-only state for CSS (:host([shown])). |
| `interactive` | `interactive` | boolean | `false` |  | A hint card: the panel stays open while the pointer is over it, a tap on touch toggles it, and it can hold links and rich content. |
| `help` | `help` | boolean | `false` |  | Draws its own info button as the target (the default slot then holds text that follows it). |
| `enrich` | `enrich` | boolean | `false` |  | Underlines the wrapped value with a dotted line to show it has context. |
| `heading` | `heading` | string | `""` |  | A bold heading inside the panel. |
| `label` | `label` | string | `"Help"` |  | Accessible name of the built-in info button. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The element the tip describes. |
| `content` | Rich tip content in place of text. |
| `links` | Links shown under the panel text (a doc link, a more link). |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-show` | `none` | The tip appeared. |
| `pk-hide` | `none` | The tip went away. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `show()` | Opens it |
| `hide()` | Closes it |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `tip` | The tooltip label |
| `help` | The built-in info button |
| `target` | Wraps the slotted target |
| `heading` | The panel heading |
| `links` | The links row |
| `body` | The panel text |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-tooltip-max-w` | `min(20rem, viewport)` | Maximum width |

**Accessibility.** The slotted target gets aria-describedby pointing at a visually-hidden copy of the text while shown, so the description crosses the shadow boundary. Escape hides it. Wrap a focusable element (button, link); never the only way to learn something essential.

Example: Tooltip on hover, focus and long press

```html
<pk-cluster><pk-tooltip text="Saves the draft without publishing"><pk-button variant="ghost">Save draft</pk-button></pk-tooltip><pk-tooltip text="Opens to the right" placement="right"><pk-button variant="ghost">Right</pk-button></pk-tooltip></pk-cluster>
```
